scene: The fossil's hollow eye shines bright, revealing three rooftop transport docks.
picture: Side-view along the museum roof edge. The dark-haired boy stands left of centre holding his skateboard and fossil skull. On the far left waits an open-door red double-decker bus. In the centre hangs a swinging wooden rope-bridge lift car. On the far right, a small paddle steamer chugs inside a rooftop water lock.
shown: a bright red double-decker bus idling on the far left roof ramp
a creaking wooden rope-bridge lift dangling in the centre beneath cables
a miniature paddle steamer moored at a rooftop canal lock far right
